purpose: Test whether pre-anchor documentary evidence of runway, moat and forward catalysts improves three-year multibagger concentration beyond snapshot-style price, ownership and financial signals.
entry_rule: first valid NSE EQ trading day strictly after anchor_date
outcome_rule: last valid NSE EQ trading day on or before outcome_target_date

document_window.known_at_rule: exchange broadcast/dissemination timestamp must be on or before anchor_date
document_window.post_anchor_revision_rule: reject any document version or revision first disseminated after anchor

discovery.request_mode: bounded symbol-by-symbol manual workflow; no scheduled full-market crawl
priority_subjects: Award of Order / Receipt of Order

features.evidence_rule: latest explicit total order book known by anchor divided by trailing revenue known by anchor; company-specific executable order book only; pipeline/tender opportunity excluded
announced incremental nameplate capacity divided by pre-expansion nameplate capacity; vague capex without measurable capacity earns missing
derive only from approved evidence categories in documentary_forward_evidence_rubric_v1.json
derive only from approved evidence categories in documentary_forward_evidence_rubric_v1.json
derive only from approved evidence categories in documentary_forward_evidence_rubric_v1.json

ranking_eligibility.score_rule: weighted earned/covered normalization using only covered features; no missing feature earns zero

outcome_safety.corporate_actions: deterministic factors only; unresolved material actions fail closed

evaluation.decision_rule: Positive diagnostic requires better 5x concentration or mean multiple, no more than 5pp adverse loss-rate delta, and non-negative rank correlation. One anchor can support further testing but cannot mutate official weights.

explicit_non_claims: This is not the full Growth Runway pillar.
This is not the full Business Moat pillar.
This is not the full Future Catalysts pillar.
Documentary category scores are evidence indices, not direct valuation or return forecasts.
No official 100-point RK-MIS weight may change from this holdout.
